result.title: Interactive image diagnosis using test-time backpropagation from the auxiliary task
result.comment: 8 pages, accepted to SPIE Medical Imaging 2025
result.summary: Multi-task deep learning has been developed to ensure explainability in computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems. These systems simultaneously predict interpretable characteristics of findings in auxiliary tasks to help radiologists assess the reliability of the diagnostic prediction. However, the CAD's opinion would not be referred to when the auxiliary task prediction deviates from the radiologist's expectation. To further leverage CAD's knowledge in the above situation, we proposed a multi-task gradient assist (MGA) method that brings interactivity to multi-task models without additional training. MGA allows radiologists to give feedback to the CAD and ask for additional diagnostic suggestions. Using two datasets of mammography and CT, we show that MGA successfully improves diagnostic accuracy upon feedback on various auxiliary tasks. Compared to an existing method using forward propagation only, MGA performs more robustly and can be combined to further improve accuracy. Our method paves a promising way for integrating artificial intelligence into image diagnosis.

AI.brief_summary: 提出多任务梯度辅助（MGA）方法，在测试时根据放射科医生对辅助任务预测的反馈进行反向传播，无需额外训练即可调整诊断建议，并在乳腺 X 线与 CT 数据上验证其准确率和鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其测试时反向传播、以辅助任务反馈调节诊断输出的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与推理期 latent 状态更新提供方法线索，但医学图像任务与 VLM 推理差异较大，梯度信号能否用于长程推理仍需核查。
